name: GEO Visitor Control
author: GEO Tools

sections.description:
GEO Visitor Control is a powerful WordPress plugin designed to give you ultimate control over who can access your website. Leveraging the industry-standard MaxMind GeoIP database, this plugin allows you to block entire countries, manage IP addresses (both allowed and banned), and control bot access with ease—all from a beautifully designed admin dashboard. Whether you’re looking to enhance security, comply with regional regulations, or simply tailor your site’s accessibility, this plugin is your go-to solution!

Imagine having the power to:
– Restrict access from specific countries with a single checkbox.
– Whitelist trusted IPs or subnets (e.g., your team or VPN).
– Blacklist malicious IPs to protect your site.
– Allow legitimate bots (like Googlebot) while keeping others out.

With GEO Visitor Control, you’re not just installing a plugin—you’re unlocking a high-potential tool that combines security, flexibility, and user-friendliness in one package. It’s perfect for:
– Business owners safeguarding sensitive content.
– Developers needing precise visitor management.
– Site admins aiming to reduce spam or unwanted traffic.

Key Features

  • Country Blocking: Easily block visitors from specific countries using an intuitive checkbox interface powered by MaxMind GeoIP.
  • IP Management: Add allowed or banned IPs/subnets for granular control—perfect for whitelisting your team or blacklisting threats.
  • Bot Control: Allow trusted bots (Google, Bing, etc.) while blocking others, based on User-Agent detection.
  • Elegant Block Page: Displays a professional, customizable “Access Denied” message to blocked visitors.
  • User-Friendly Dashboard: Three intuitive tabs (Blocked Countries, Allowed Bots, Allowed/Banned IPs) make configuration a breeze.
  • High Performance: Lightweight and optimized—checks run seamlessly on every front-end page load.
  • Secure & Reliable: Built with WordPress best practices, including data sanitization and access checks.

Why Choose GEO Visitor Control?

This isn’t just another geolocation plugin—it’s a game-changer. The integration with MaxMind GeoIP ensures accurate location detection, while the robust feature set empowers you to tailor access like never before. Whether you’re protecting a membership site, complying with GDPR, or simply keeping unwanted visitors at bay, GEO Visitor Control delivers unmatched value. Its potential to improve security and user experience makes it a must-have for any serious WordPress site owner.

Start today and experience the peace of mind that comes with total visitor control—download GEO Visitor Control now!

sections.installation:
1. Upload the geo-visitor-control folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Place the MaxMind GeoIP database file (geo.mmdb) in the /geo folder inside the plugin directory (e.g., /wp-content/plugins/geo-visitor-control/geo/geo.mmdb).
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. Navigate to the GEO Visitor Control menu in your WordPress dashboard to configure settings.
  5. (Optional) Install the MaxMind GeoIP2 PHP library via Composer (composer require geoip2/geoip2) for full functionality.
sections.faq:
What does GEO Visitor Control do?

GEO Visitor Control lets you block visitors from specific countries, manage IP access (allow or ban specific IPs/subnets), and control which bots can access your site—all powered by the MaxMind GeoIP database.

Do I need a MaxMind account?

Yes, you’ll need to download the GeoLite2 database (free) or a paid MaxMind database and place it in the /geo folder of the plugin. No API key is required for basic functionality.

How do I block a country?

Simply go to the “Blocked Countries” tab in the plugin’s dashboard, check the boxes for the countries you want to block, and click “Save Settings.” It’s that easy!

Can I allow specific IPs even if their country is blocked?

Absolutely! Add those IPs to the “Allowed IPs” list, and they’ll bypass all other restrictions.

Will this slow down my site?

No! The plugin is optimized for performance, with efficient checks that run only on front-end page loads and skip admin users.

What happens when a visitor is blocked?

They’ll see a clean, professional “Access Denied” page explaining the restriction. You can customize this page by modifying the plugin code if needed.

Can I allow search engine bots like Googlebot?

Yes! The “Allowed Bots” tab lets you whitelist specific bots by their User-Agent, ensuring search engines can still crawl your site.

Is it secure?

Yes, the plugin follows WordPress coding standards, sanitizes all inputs, and includes access checks to ensure only admins can modify settings.

What if I don’t have the MaxMind database file?

The plugin will still work for IP and bot management, but country-based blocking requires the geo.mmdb file to function.
